newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: SOCCER-ETHIOPIA BANS PLAYERS WHO WENT MISSING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ETHIOPIA BANS PLAYERS WHO WENT MISSING.

text.p: The Ethiopian Football Federation has temporarily banned six members of its national soccer squad who returned home after seeking political asylum in Italy.
State television on Wednesday night quoted the federation as saying the six players, and any more who returned in due course, would be temporarily banned from club and national competitions.

The six changed their minds and agreed to return home after seeking asylum in Italy with 10 other members of the squad this month. They disappeared from a Rome hotel during a stopover en route to Morocco.
